name: Swift Reconfiguration
oracle_text:
Flash
Enchant creature or Vehicle
Enchanted permanent is a Vehicle artifact with crew 5 and it loses all other card types. (It's not a creature unless it's crewed.)
blocked_sentences: Enchanted permanent is a Vehicle artifact with crew 5 and it loses all other card types. (It's not a creature unless it's crewed.)

needs.what: a layer-4 type-setting static ("is a Vehicle artifact ... loses all other card types") that is ordered by timestamp against later animations, so that the granted Crew 5 ability's "becomes an artifact creature until end of turn" (an `animate` adding Creature, with a later timestamp than the Aura) still makes the enchanted permanent a creature after it is crewed (613.7)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `set_types` static (types: ["Artifact"], plus an `add_subtype` static for Vehicle and a `grant_ability` static handing over a crew ability whose cost is tap_permanents total_power 5 and whose effect is `animate`) would load, but `derive_characteristics` applies every `set_types` static AFTER all animations and replaces the type set wholesale (`types = set(static.get("types"))`), so the crew animation's Creature type is always erased: the enchanted permanent could be crewed and never become a creature, a silently wrong card
